items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I only came in contact with him once or twice, but he was a very good pianist for singers.

ctx.x: about Jelly Roll and we talked about Edgar Hays and we talked about Claude Hopkins. And the Lion, and Lucky Roberts. What about Casey the photographer? What was his name? Chitteson?
I only came in contact with him once or twice, but he was a very good pianist for singers.
